quote: Here, we show that, despite the restricted intestinal expression of sPLA2-IIA in BALB/c mice, its genetic deletion leads to amelioration of cancer and exacerbation of psoriasis in distal skin.
summary: Pla2g2a deletion in mice reduced skin cancer but worsened psoriasis via altered gut microbiota; no colitis outcome was measured.

quote: Knockdown of PLA2G2A, PLA2G5, or ALOX15 can reverse the ferroptosis phenotypes, suggesting that they are downstream effectors of SELENOI.
summary: PLA2G2A is upregulated when Selenoi is lost, and its knockdown reverses the ferroptosis phenotype that impairs intestinal regeneration in colitis models.

quote: We also identified genetic variants influencing sPLA2-IIA using genome-wide association and examined them with CVD.
summary: In a cardiovascular trial, PLA2G2A variant rs11573156 strongly affected sPLA2-IIA mass, which was associated with CVD risk; nothing on UC.

quote: A higher expression of Pla2g2a was detected in C3H mice.
summary: Colonic Pla2g2a expression differed between germ-free mouse strains after colonization with the same microbiota, being higher in C3H mice; no colitis.

quote: Expression of Pla2g2a also inhibited tumor progression.
summary: A Pla2g2a transgene strongly reduced intestinal tumorigenesis in Muc2-deficient mice, indicating a protective role for the mucosa; colitis was not directly measured.

quote: Pla2g2a: Phospholipase A2, group IIA
summary: Pla2g2a appears only in an abbreviation list in a paper on FABP4 regulation of Paneth cell defensins.

quote: In the intestine, Paneth cell-derived sPLA2-IIA acts as an antimicrobial protein to shape the gut microbiota, thereby secondarily affecting inflammation, allergy, and cancer in proximal and distal tissues.
summary: Review of sPLA2-IIA as a Paneth cell antimicrobial protein shaping gut microbiota, with knockout and overexpression effects on skin, allergy, cancer and arthritis.

quote: Moreover, AOM-induced duodenal tumors were also attenuated by Pla2g2a expression.
summary: Pla2g2a transgene strongly inhibited azoxymethane-induced colon tumours in mice and suppressed interferon-induced genes; no colitis model.

quote: A diagnostic model incorporating the three disease-specific genes PPARG, PLA2G2A, and IDO1 demonstrated high accuracy in distinguishing between the UC group and the control group.
summary: PLA2G2A is one of three genes in a diagnostic model that separated UC from controls accurately; the paper's focus is PPARG.

quote: Further analysis revealed that genes related to the immune response (DUOX2, PLA2G2A, CXCL9), DNA transcription (CTR9), protein processing (JOSD1, URI1), and ion transport (SLC9A3) remained dysregulated even after budesonide-induced remission.
summary: PLA2G2A is named among genes still dysregulated after budesonide-induced remission in collagenous colitis, without a specific result.

quote: Phospholipase A2 Group IIA (PLA2G2A) was first identified as a possible biomarker for UC, with AUC values of 0.810 and 1.000 in the two validation sets, while in animal models the gene showed similarly significant up-regulation in damaged intestinal mucosa.
summary: PLA2G2A was a diagnostic biomarker for UC (AUC 0.81 and 1.0), upregulated in damaged mucosa in mice and correlated with immune cells and histological severity.

quote: Partial transcriptome analysis showed that expression of Paneth cell-associated antimicrobial peptides Lyz1, Pla2g2a, and Defa6 was down-regulated markedly in Ptpn2-KO mice compared with wild-type and heterozygous.
summary: Ileal Pla2g2a expression fell markedly in Ptpn2-knockout mice alongside Paneth cell loss; Pla2g2a itself was not perturbed.

quote: Among these, a subset of inflammation-related proteins including fibrinogen-β and -γ chains (FGB and FGG), phospholipase A2 (PLA2G2A) and SPARC was significantly downregulated in the presence of Aquamin® (alone and in combination with LPS-cytokines); another subset of proteins with anti-inflammatory, antioxidant or anti-microbial activity was upregulated by Aquamin® treatment.
summary: PLA2G2A protein was reduced by a multi-mineral treatment in human colon organoids, with and without inflammatory stimuli; the gene was not perturbed.

quote: Transcriptome analysis revealed that L. plantarum L47 and inulin up-regulated the gene expression of phospholipase A2 group IIA (PLA2G2A) (P L. plantarum L47 and inulin increased the levels of ALA (P P P P = 0.05) in the ileal mucosa.
summary: In ETEC-challenged piglets, a probiotic plus inulin raised ileal PLA2G2A expression alongside less inflammation; the gene was not directly manipulated.

quote: Using network topology parameters, phenotype associations, and functional similarity analysis with ACE2 and TMPRSS2-two key receptors for this virus-we identified 17 genes with high connectivity (CXCL10, IDO1, LEPR, MME, PTAFR, PTGS2, MAOB, PDE4B, PLA2G2A, COL5A1, ICAM1, SERPINE1, ABCB1, IL1R1, ITGAL, NCAM1 and PRKD1) potentially contributing to the clinical severity of COVID-19 infection in patients with comorbidities.
summary: PLA2G2A is one of 17 high-connectivity genes in a COVID-19 comorbidity network analysis; not about UC.

quote: Genes involved in the extracellular matrix (Col1a1, Fn1) and innate immunity (RatNP-3, Pla2g2a) were induced by AOM in all diets, but to a lower extent in bean-fed animals.
summary: In rat colonic mucosa, Pla2g2a was induced by azoxymethane and less so with bean diets; this is a carcinogenesis model, not colitis.

quote: ELAM-1 plays a significant role in mediating adhesion of resting CD4+ T cells to activated HUVEC.
summary: In vitro, ELAM-1 mediates adhesion of resting CD4+ T cells to activated endothelial cells; no colitis or gut outcome was measured.

quote: ELAM-1:endothelial-leukocyte adhesion molecule-1
summary: ELAM-1 appears only in the abbreviation list of a review of anti-inflammatory plant compounds.

quote: However, high levels of ELAM-1 were consistently found on endothelial surfaces in association with active inflammation in affected areas of colonic mucosa in patients with either ulcerative colitis (n = 27) or Crohn's colitis (n = 9).
summary: ELAM-1 was absent in normal or quiescent colonic mucosa but high on endothelium in active UC and Crohn's colitis, and in tamarin colitis.

quote: This transcriptome enriches key AD pathways more than the individual studies, and associates AD with novel pathways, such as atherosclerosis signaling (IL-37, selectin E/SELE).
summary: SELE is named as part of an atherosclerosis pathway in an atopic dermatitis skin meta-analysis; not about UC.

quote: Intracolonic administration of anti-ELAM-1 or anti-ICAM-1 antibody decreased bloody stools, anaemia, and histologically evident damage, as well as myeloperoxidase activity and IL-1beta content.
summary: Blocking ELAM-1 with an intracolonic antibody reduced DSS colitis severity in mice, and ELAM-1 was upregulated on inflamed vessels.

quote: We found an elevated ratio of HLA-DR and CD122-, CD62E-, and CD62L-expressing cells among the CD4+ T lymphocytes in PE in comparison to healthy pregnancy.
summary: CD62E-expressing CD4+ T cells were more frequent in preeclampsia blood; not about UC or IBD.

quote: ELAM-1 was preferentially expressed in venules in actively inflamed mucosa and granulation tissue.
summary: ELAM-1 was expressed in venules of actively inflamed IBD mucosa, sparse in normal mucosa, with signs of active synthesis and secretion by endothelial cells.

quote: Nine key prognostic genes were identified and were used to construct a TME-related prognostic signature: CADM3, LEP, CD1B, PDE1B, CCL22, ABI3BP, IGLON5, SELE, and TGFB1.
summary: SELE is one of nine genes in a colon cancer prognostic signature; not about UC.

quote: However, a low expression of GNG11, LRRK2, CDH5, CAV1 and SELE was associated with a worse OS for the female lung cancer patients who never smoked.
summary: SELE is one of several hub genes whose low expression tracked with worse survival in non-smoking female lung cancer; not about UC.
